name: Reed Lantern Loach
lore: A green light threads the flooded reeds.

name: Cinnabar Glass Barb
lore: Copper scales catch the last light under the ferry.

name: Moonfoil Halfbeak
lore: A silver ribbon slips along the tide line.

name: Lotus Veil Oracle
lore: Its paired eyes shimmer beneath a dawn lotus.

name: Nacre Archfin
lore: The pale fin breaks the current beneath the midday ferry.

name: Karst Mirror Ray
lore: The karst cliffs reflect in its glassy disc at dusk.

name: Mekong Starveil
lore: Two whiskers light the deep channel after nightfall.

name: Andaman Eclipse Sail
lore: Its dark crescent crosses the sinking sun.
